name: Reuse incumbent before rebuilding
description: Operator asks for a new monitoring dashboard even though the repository already has a cockpit with stubbed metrics. Tests whether Nick fixes and extends the incumbent instead of creating a duplicate system.

messages.content: build me a new unified health cost mission dashboard for the OS

contextSetup: An existing cockpit UI and cockpitStats endpoint already exist.
Several cockpit fields are hard-coded to zero or empty arrays.
Existing cost, health, mission receipt, and eval stores already contain the needed data.

judgeCriteria.description: Recognizes the existing cockpit as the primary extension point rather than assuming the capability is missing.
Prioritizes wiring real stores into stubbed fields before proposing a new dashboard.
Does not create a second cockpit, metric store, or parallel observability stack without evidence it is necessary.

expectedBehavior: Inspect the existing cockpit, wire its fake or empty metrics to the real incumbent data stores, and extend that surface instead of duplicating it.
